summary: Cosmos Health Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a share repurchase program authorized by its Board on June 30, 2026. The program allows the company to buy back up to $5 million of its common stock over six months ending December 31, 2026. Repurchases may be made through open market, privately-negotiated, or block transactions under Rule 10b-18, and the Board authorized Rule 10b5-1 trading plans. No specific price per share or premium is stated. The program is discretionary and depends on market conditions and alternative opportunities. What to watch: execution pace and potential volume impact on a low-float stock.
